cases.prompt: Reproduce the supplied desktop screenshot faithfully. After coding, source code looks right but browser capture is unavailable.
must: report what source-level preparation was possible
request/bind an inspectable render before fidelity claim
must_not: use matching CSS values as proof of rendered match
cases.oracle: completion gate blocks strict visual-fidelity claim in absence of target-vs-render evidence

cases.prompt: The implementation matches layout but uses a different font, warmer background, generic icons and slightly larger radii than the accepted mock.
must: rank typography/color/icon/shape mismatches as fidelity drift
repair high-perceptual-impact mismatch before micro polish
cases.oracle: fidelity ledger identifies target/render deltas by region/dimension and repairs follow perceptual priority

cases.prompt: Desktop target is accepted; no mobile reference exists, but mobile behavior is required.
must: derive mobile adaptation from product/interaction/responsive constraints
distinguish faithful desktop claim from designed mobile extension
must_not: claim mobile is faithful to a nonexistent target
cases.oracle: evidence/claim clearly separates reproduced axes from newly designed responsive behavior
